verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants and agents operate the product conversationally: 'ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, or submit a reimbursement' without opening the app. It covers card management, transaction queries, reimbursements and bill pay. This natural-language operation runs only through an external AI client connected to the MCP server; there is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the Jeeves app itself. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably across these workflows.
